blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Faced with declining tourist arrivals and concerns over expensive food and services, the provincial government is banking on new international flights, fair pricing and sustainable tourism to restore travelers’ confidence in Bohol, Gov. Erico Aristotle Aumentado said on Friday. In his State of the Province Address (Sopa), Aumentado acknowledged the tourism downturn in 2026, saying the decline was not confined to Bohol but was also being experienced by destinations nationwide and globally. Tourist arrivals plunged nearly 22 percent in the first half of 2026, with travel agencies reporting a dearth of bookings and some resorts cutting jobs […]...
